product-hero.description: A generous product introduction with a gradient title and call to action.
product-hero.yaml:
# Composition preset: product-hero. Edit this file freely.
type: compose
version: 1
label: Introduction
padding: loose
layout:
  kind: stack
  align: center
  gap: large
children:
  - type: heading
    level: 1
    scale: display
    text: Make room for your next idea.
    gradient:
      colors:
        - "#b94c25"
        - "#df9b55"
      effect: reveal
  - type: text
    size: lead
    text: A clear introduction to what you make, who it helps, and why it matters.
  - type: button
    label: Explore the story
    href: "#"

split-story.description: An editorial image and a compact story, with a reversible split layout.
split-story.yaml:
# Composition preset: split-story. Edit this file freely.
type: compose
version: 1
label: The story
layout:
  kind: split
  ratio: wide-start
  align: center
  gap: large
children:
  - type: image
    image: assets/replace-me.svg
    alt: Describe the story illustrated by your image
    caption: Add context to the illustration.
  - type: group
    children:
      - type: heading
        text: Every detail has a reason.
      - type: text
        size: lead
        text: Tell the story behind one thoughtful choice. Keep the focus on what it means for your reader.
      - type: button
        label: Read more
        href: "#"
        style: ghost

# Replace the placeholder images with your own content/assets files before building.

feature-cards.description: Three equal-height feature cards with theme-aware surfaces.
feature-cards.yaml:
# Composition preset: feature-cards. Edit this file freely.
type: compose
version: 1
label: Details
children:
  - type: heading
    text: Small details. Lasting differences.
  - type: group
    layout:
      kind: grid
      columns: 3
      align: stretch
    children:
      - type: group
        surface: tinted
        padding: medium
        radius: large
        children:
          - type: heading
            level: 3
            scale: subtitle
            text: A clear beginning.
          - type: text
            text: Explain how your reader gets started.
      - type: group
        surface: tinted
        padding: medium
        radius: large
        children:
          - type: heading
            level: 3
            scale: subtitle
            text: Room to grow.
          - type: text
            text: Describe how the experience adapts to new needs.
      - type: group
        surface: tinted
        padding: medium
        radius: large
        children:
          - type: heading
            level: 3
            scale: subtitle
            text: Thoughtfully finished.
          - type: text
            text: Show the care behind one useful detail.

media-accordion.description: Selectable feature stories with a synchronized illustration and sequential fallbacks.
media-accordion.yaml:
# Composition preset: media-accordion. Edit this file freely.
type: compose
version: 1
label: A closer look
children:
  - type: heading
    text: A closer look at the details.
  - type: media-accordion
    label: Explore the details
    items:
      - title: Start with the essentials.
        body: Explain one useful feature in **plain language**.
        image: assets/replace-me.svg
        alt: Describe the first feature illustration
      - title: Find a new perspective.
        body: Give the reader another reason to explore.
        image: assets/replace-me.svg
        alt: Describe the second feature illustration
      - title: Make it your own.
        body: Show how this detail fits the reader’s needs.
        image: assets/replace-me.svg
        alt: Describe the third feature illustration
